test_gtn_equal: test two gtn graphs for structural equality including nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn graphs are isomorphic ignoring node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn graph using gtn.save and gtn.load
